mapper.sql: SELECT p.ptnr_id,p.ptnr_no,p.ptnr_se_cd,p.ptnr_nm,p.biz_reg_no,p.ceo_nm,p.indty_cd,p.chrg_nm,p.chrg_tel_no, CASE WHEN p.ptnr_se_cd!='VEND' THEN p.txinv_email_addr END AS txinv_email_addr,p.use_yn,k.cd_nm AS "kindName",i.cd_nm AS "industryName", CASE WHEN p.ptnr_se_cd!='CUST' AND p.acnt_no IS NOT NULL THEN b.cd_nm || ' …' || right(p.acnt_no,4) END AS "paymentAccount", CASE WHEN p.ptnr_se_cd='VEND' THEN NULL ELSE ( SELECT count(DISTINCT r.prj_id) FROM prj.prj r WHERE r.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN','HOLD') AND (r.cust_ptnr_id=p.ptnr_id OR (p.ptnr_se_cd='BOTH' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id WHERE a.prj_id=r.prj_id AND d.vndr_ptnr_id=p.ptnr_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.end_dt >= #{today}))) ) END AS "projectCount", (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.dev_id) FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj r ON r.prj_id=a.prj_id JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id WHERE r.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN','HOLD') AND a.asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.end_dt >= #{today} AND ((p.ptnr_se_cd IN ('CUST','BOTH') AND r.cust_ptnr_id=p.ptnr_id) OR (p.ptnr_se_cd IN ('VEND','BOTH') AND d.vndr_ptnr_id=p.ptnr_id))) AS "assignmentPeopleCount" FROM mst.ptnr p LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl k ON k.cd_grp_id='PARTNER_KIND' AND k.dtl_cd=p.ptnr_se_cd LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl i ON i.cd_grp_id='INDUSTRY' AND i.dtl_cd=p.indty_cd LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl b ON b.cd_grp_id='BANK' AND b.dtl_cd=p.bank_cd
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM () rows ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: SELECT ptnr_id,ptnr_no,ptnr_se_cd,ptnr_nm,biz_reg_no,ceo_nm,indty_cd,chrg_nm,chrg_tel_no,rmrk_desc, CASE WHEN ptnr_se_cd!='VEND' THEN txinv_email_addr END AS txinv_email_addr, CASE WHEN ptnr_se_cd!='CUST' THEN bank_cd END AS bank_cd,CASE WHEN ptnr_se_cd!='CUST' THEN acnt_no END AS acnt_no, CASE WHEN ptnr_se_cd!='CUST' THEN dpstr_nm END AS dpstr_nm,use_yn FROM mst.ptnr WHERE ptnr_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ptnr_nm FROM mst.ptnr WHERE biz_reg_no=#{biz}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cmn.cd_dtl d JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=d.cd_grp_id WHERE d.cd_grp_id=#{group} AND d.dtl_cd=#{code} AND d.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y')
